utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Mara, I’m still waiting on the organizers to confirm the repair drive date, repair list, time window, and drop-off/tool spots, but I’m checking in today and I’ll pass along anything solid as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’ve only got the 3:30 to 6 window and Cleo’s shed supply list noted so far, so I’ll wait for your confirmed date, repair list, and drop-off/tool spots before I mark anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Mara — I’ll treat that 3:30 to 6 window and Cleo’s shed list as tentative until the organizers confirm, and I’ll circle back as soon as I have something solid.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Jules, I’m still slammed and haven’t checked the garage or side shed yet, so don’t count anything from me as confirmed until I ping Opal and Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo — I won’t count anything from you as confirmed yet. I’m also holding the public details loosely until Eli or Leo clears up the time conflict and Rosa/Opal confirm the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks — I’ll keep it that way and send a quick note once I’ve actually checked those spots.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Kira—have you heard the confirmed repair list and drop-off spot from Eli or Leo yet? I promised Leo I’d only pass along final details, not guesses.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet, Ira—I’ve only heard Oren still needed to check with Eli or Leo. Can you confirm with Leo directly before we tell anyone the repair list or drop-off spot?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’ll check with Leo directly and won’t share anything until he confirms the repair list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Leo, I’m planning around school pickup, so I can cover setup and sign-in from 3:30 to 5:30 if that still works—could you send Ira’s confirmed repair list and the final drop-off details when you have them?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye—that window helps. I’m still waiting on Ira for the confirmed list and drop-off spot, and I’ll send them as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—that works for me. I’ll hold 3:30 to 5:30 for setup and sign-in, and I’ll watch for the details once Ira confirms.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Pia, I’m set to help Saturday at nine with snacks, sign-ups, and checking drop-off spots, and I’ll share Leo and Ira’s final repair list as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam—before we tell more folks, can we confirm with Tess whether it’s really Saturday at nine or the 10 to 2 time Quinn mentioned? I just don’t want snacks, sign-ups, and drop-offs planned around the wrong window.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Good call, Pia—I’ll check with Tess before we spread the word, and I’ll hold off on locking snacks, sign-ups, or drop-offs until we confirm whether it’s nine or 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Vik, I’ve got Saturday the 15th at nine in my head as confirmed by Eli, but I still need to check with Eli or Leo before I pass along the final repair list or drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—I’ll hold off on calling it final, but I’ll tell folks you’ve heard Saturday the 15th at nine from Eli and that the repair list and drop-off spot still need checking with Eli or Leo.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik, that’s exactly right—Saturday the 15th at nine from Eli, and I’ll double-check the repair list and drop-off spot with Eli or Leo before we spread those bits.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, I’m still probably arriving a little late, but I’ll check in by the shed when I get there and help with tool sorting or hauling, whichever Cleo needs most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Dane; I’ll mark you as arriving late and checking in by the shed, then helping Cleo with tool sorting or hauling as needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Eli — that’s exactly right. If anything changes before I get there, just have Cleo or Vik point me toward the biggest backlog.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Nell, I’ve got two toolboxes, the spare drill, a full bit set, and a heavy-duty extension cord set aside for the repair drive; I’m just waiting on the final repair list and drop-off spot before I bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s great, Gus—Rosa’s gathering repair requests this week to match volunteers, and Quinn told me it’s Saturday 10 to 2 at the community center, drop-in. I haven’t heard a separate tool drop-off spot yet, so I’ll pass along what you’ve got and check before sending you anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I’ll keep the tools set aside and wait for the confirmed drop-off spot before hauling anything over.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Noah, before I add anything to the repair drive list, can you tell me what needs fixing, where it is, how urgent it feels, and whether anyone has already offered supplies or help?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m sorry, Hana—I don’t have a confirmed list or drop-off spot yet, just that folks are still gathering repair needs and tool volunteers. If you’ve got something to add, maybe note the item, location, urgency, and any supplies offered, but I’d wait for Eli or Leo before treating it as final.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll keep everything unconfirmed for now and only note items with location, urgency, and any offered help until Eli or Leo confirms the list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Quinn, I’ve got the supply list by the shed, and Gus’s drill, bit set, and extension cord are already covered. We still need tar paper, roofing nails, patch boards, rail brackets, exterior screws, and spare sandpaper if folks can bring any.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll pass that around, but I’m also going to mention Tess is still confirming the final repair drive details so folks don’t get mixed messages.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s perfect, Quinn — tell folks I’ll keep the supply list current by the shed, and Tess can confirm the final timing and details so we stay coordinated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still piecing it together, Opal, but I heard the shed roof and porch rails may come first. I’m checking with Mina before bringing tools so we don’t double up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey — I’ll mark shed roof and porch rails as possible priorities, not confirmed yet, and note that you’re checking with Mina before bringing tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds right, thanks. I’ll keep it tentative until Mina or Leo confirms the list and drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Rosa, Nell said to check in with you Saturday at 10. I can sort tools or carry supplies, wherever you need a quiet extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that help would be wonderful, but the drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. I’m collecting repair requests and volunteer skills this week, so I’ll mark you down for tool sorting and carrying supplies.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sunday at the community center, then—I’ll be there and stick to sorting tools or carrying supplies where you point me. Thanks for keeping track of it, Rosa.
